endorsements.name: I)ruid
endorsements.label: MSF Telephony
endorsements.description: An important attack vector missing in many penetration testing and attack tools available today is the tried-and-true telephony dial-up. With the recent surge in popularity of VoIP connectivity, accessing such attack vectors has become both cheap and easy. Using the new Metasploit telephony components, users are now able to both scan for and dial up directly to telephony-accessible exploitation targets.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 17
